programme.title: Gary Burton & Makoto Ozone
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic. In 1995, vibraphonist Gary Burton and pianist Makoto Ozone, both great jazz players noted for their virtuoso technique and innovative style, came together to give a concert of improvised music. They delighted the audience with their fluid, poetic artistry, which was expressed in a performance of the highest order.

programme.title: Wes Montgomery
programme.desc: This selection of unforgettable performances by some of the most iconic and influential jazz guitarists in history showcases these legends' unique essence. Revel in Wes Montgomery's virtuosity as he performs the captivating “Nica's Dream” in Holland in 1965, and delight in the expressive beauty of his rendition of “Here's That Rainy Day”, recorded in London in that same year. Experience the timeless appeal of Joe Pass's “You Stepped Out of a Dream” and “You Turned The Tables on Me”, recorded live in Hanover in 1975. The interplay between Jim Hall and Atilla Zoller borders on the impossible as they perform “Extensions” in Hanover in 1973. Enjoy Jim Hall's lyrical solo performance of “I'm Getting Sentimental Over You” from 1964. Witness Sonny Sharrock's avant-garde fusion of jazz and rock in an exhilarating performance of “Peanut", recorded live in France in 1970. Sharrock is joined by flutist Herbie Mann in a soulful performance of “Memphis Underground” from 1969. Immerse yourself in the magic of jazz guitar!

programme.title: Dionne Warwick
programme.sub-title: Dionne Warwick live at the 27 Club
programme.desc: Dionne Warwick's vocal artistry ranges from voluminous deep register to soft, fragile high notes. She masters the entire range with almost unnerving ease. But more than her strong, warm voice, Dionne's magic is in the silky elegance and the secure delivery with which she tells a story. That's how her, along with composer Burt Bacharach and lyricist Hal David become pioneers of the brand of pop music called “Middle of the Road”, meaning pop that is grippingly simple, but never trite. Sixty of her hits made it into the American charts and sold over 100 million albums worldwide. This amazing 1964 recording from the 27 Club in Knokke, Belgium showcases the 23-year-old star vocalist at the start of her career.

programme.title: Spyro Gyra
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival's staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1982, the American jazz fusion band Spyro Gyra took the stage at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague. Having struck gold with their album "Morning Dance" just a few years prior, they played a slick set with exuberant energy.

programme.title: Franz Welser-Möst, Cleveland Orchestra & Víkingur Ólafsson
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst conducts the Cleveland Orchestra in a program recorded at Severance Music Center in Cleveland in March 2023. On the program are Louise Farrenc's Symphony No. 3, Ravel's Piano Concerto in G (featuring Vïkingur Ólafsson as soloist) and Mussorgsky's Pictures at an Exhibition (orchestration by Ravel).

programme.title: Soloists of the Lucerne Festival Orchestra

programme.title: Philippe Jordan & Orchestre de l'Opéra national de Paris
programme.sub-title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 6 in F major, Op. 68
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l'Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven's symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven's Symphony No. 6 in F major, Op. 68, also known as the Pastoral Symphony. Beethoven wrote the work upon completion of his Symphony No. 5. Both symphonies premiered at the same legendary, all-Beethoven concert on December 22, 1808. Symphony No. 6 consists of five movements, of which the last three are played without a break. Each movement carries a title that suggests a scene from life in the countryside. The joyful atmosphere of the first three movements is interrupted by the violent fourth movement ‘Thunder, Storm', as expressed by the piccolos, brass, and timpani. As the storm recedes at the end of the movement, the tranquility returns in the final movement. This performance was recorded at Opéra Bastille in Paris, France, in 2015.

programme.title: Carlos Miguel Prieto, Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería, Ruxandra Donose & Ramón Vargas
programme.sub-title: Mahler – The Song of the Earth
programme.desc: Mahler: Das Lied von der Erde, performed live by Carlos Miguel Prieto conducting the Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería, with mezzo-soprano Ruxandra Donose and tenor Ramón Vargas, presents Mahler's song-symphony — one of the composer's most profound masterpieces.

programme.title: Mariss Jansons, Berliner Philharmoniker & Hilary Hahn
programme.desc: The Berliner Philharmoniker is one of the world's finest orchestras, its fame stretching all the way to Japan. Unsurprisingly, this 2000 concert, recorded at Tokyo's magnificent Suntory Hall, was a resounding success. Mariss Jansons conducts a beautiful program that includes Antonin Dvorák's Symphony No. 8, Carl Maria von Weber's Overture to Oberon, and Dmitri Shostakovich's Violin Concerto featuring star violinist Hilary Hahn (*1979)

programme.title: A Murderer Upstairs
programme.desc: (2017) Taut thriller starring Josie Davis. After her stepdaughter witnesses a murder, Cindy tries to protect her. But as the truth unravels, is the greatest danger living under her own roof?

programme.title: Perfect Plan
programme.desc: (2010) Tense thriller with Emily Rose. Realtor Lauren is elated when she lands a cash buyer for an expensive mansion. But when the owners are found murdered, is this sweet deal part of a deadly plan?

programme.title: Abduction
programme.desc: A thriller centered on a young man who sets out to uncover the truth about his life after finding his baby photo on a missing persons website.

programme.title: The Internship
programme.desc: Billy (Vince Vaughn) and Nick (Owen Wilson) are salesmen whose careers have been torpedoed by the digital world. Trying to prove they are not obsolete, they defy the odds by talking their way into a coveted internship at Google, along with a battalion of brilliant college students.

programme.title: Masterminds
programme.desc: David Ghantt is a simple man stuck in a monotonous life. Every day he drives an armored car, transporting millions with no escape in sight. The only bit of excitement is his crush Kelly Campbell, who lures him into the scheme of a lifetime.

programme.title: Monte Carlo
programme.desc: Grace (Selena Gomez) is an ordinary girl who becomes an accidental princess when a family summer trip to Paris turns into the fantasy of a lifetime. Living like royalty, Grace, along with her two best friends, discovers who she really is – by assuming another person's identity.

programme.title: Starting Up Love
programme.desc: When workaholic Jillian gets a note that her long-lost, wealthy uncle has passed away, she finds he's left her his beautiful mountainside cabin – and a family she never knew existed. Jillian's plan is to sell the cabin as soon as possible and move on, but when she meets handsome caretaker Liam, he makes her an offer she can't refuse. Sparks fly as they work together to transform the cabin into a holiday resort. When business doesn't go as planned and she almost loses her newfound family, Jillian needs to make a decision. Will she give up everything for the love she never saw coming?

programme.title: Cooking Up Love
programme.desc: On a lark, Zoey rents a food truck and enters a reality TV competition. Heat rises between her and the handsome founder of a fast food chain, but when Zoey finds out he's a judge in the contest, things quickly fizzle. Zoey's determined to win fair and square and she suspects Mr-Too-Good-To-Be-True is really after her sauce recipe, not her heart.

programme.title: Dino Time
programme.desc: Three kids who travel back in time to 65 million years ago, where they are taken in by a dinosaur. AKA Back to the Jurassic

programme.title: Monsieur Verdoux
programme.desc: A suave but cynical man supports his family by marrying and murdering rich women for their money, but the job has some occupational hazards.

programme.title: Dreamin Wild
programme.desc: What if a childhood dream suddenly came true - but thirty years later? That's what happened to singer/songwriter Donnie Emerson. His dream of success suddenly – and unexpectedly – came true but only as he approached 50 years old.

programme.title: Uptown Girls (2003)
programme.desc: Molly Gunn is the daughter of a late rock legend, and the toast of New York City. But when her inheritance is stolen, Molly is forced to do something she's never done before - get a job. Molly becomes a nanny to a girl, who is "eight going on forty."

programme.title: Hoosiers
programme.desc: A man gets a last-chance job coaching a small-town Indiana high-school basketball team and faces the dual challenge of bringing this underdog team to the 1951 state championship and redeeming himself from a mysterious past.

programme.title: Scoop
programme.desc: An American journalism student in London scoops a big story, and begins an affair with an aristocrat as the incident unfurls.

programme.title: Mechanic: Resurrection
programme.desc: Arthur Bishop thought he had put his murderous past behind him when a foe kidnaps the love of his life.

programme.title: Escape Plan
programme.desc: The world's authority on structural security accepts a job to break out of an ultra-secret, high-tech facility

programme.title: The Expendables
programme.desc: A CIA operative hires a team of mercenaries to eliminate a Latin dictator and a renegade CIA agent.

programme.title: The Expendables 2
programme.desc: When one of The Expendables is murdered on the job, their quest for revenge puts them deep in enemy territory.

programme.title: Me, Myself and Di
programme.desc: After winning the 'trip of a lifetime' to a caravan park in Rhyl, North Wales, unlucky in love Northerner, Janet Brown, is ready for a holiday romance. Unfortunately, following the advice of best friend Diana (Lucy Pinder) - that Janet should pretend to be the opposite of who she actually is in order to find love - doesn't quite lead to the happily ever after she was hoping for. A laugh-out-loud gritty rom-com with a huge ensemble cast including James Lance (Northern Soul, Bronson, Marie Antoinette, Bel Ami), Will Mellor (Two Pints of Lager and a Packet of Crisps, Line of Duty), Larry Lamb (EastEnders, The Hatton Garden Job), Marek Oravec (Captain America: The First Avenger), Wim Snape (The Full Monty, Coronation Street), and Katy Clayton (Casualty, Shameless).

programme.title: Gladiatress
programme.desc: 55BC Somewhere In Britain: The Princesses of the Dubonni tribe are three unlikely sisters: Smirgut The Fierce (Fiona Allen), ferocious warrior and full-time mum, Dwyfuc (Doon Mackichan), desperate spinster in search of a hairy husband and Worthaboutapig (Sally Phillips), clumsy village bee-herder. Roman soldiers kidnap Dwyfuc, detaining her in Boulogne. Seduced by Roman society, she reveals locations of British ports crucial to the Romanss invasion strategy. Smirgut and Worthaboutapig set out on a perilous rescue mission together they must prevent the downfall of Celtic Britain, encountering gods, lawyers, soothsayers, barbarians and the Otherworld. Girl power is alive and kicking and ready to take on the Romans

programme.title: Pandorum
programme.desc: Two astronauts (Dennis Quaid, Vantage Point and Ben Foster, 30 Days of Night) awaken in a hyper-sleep chamber aboard a seemingly abandoned spacecraft. It's pitch black, they are disoriented, and the only sound is a low rumble and creak from the belly of the ship. They can't remember anything like who they are and what their mission is, but one thing they do realise very quickly is that they are not alone. Slowly the spacecraft's shocking, deadly secrets are revealed and the astronauts find that they must fight to stay alive and that their survival is more important than they could ever have imagined. Directed by Christian Alvart and also starring Cam Gigandet (Twilight), Cung Le (Tekken) and newcomer Antje Traue.

programme.title: Lady Bloodfight
programme.desc: Jane is a beautiful but troubled American girl backpacking her way through Hong Kong. When she successfully fends off three thugs trying to rob her, it draws the attention of Shu, a Wudang champion, who is impressed by her raw street fighting abilities. Shu recruits Jane and trains her to fight in the vicious, all-female, underground martial arts tournament known as The Kumite.

programme.title: The Professor
programme.desc: Johnny Depp plays Richard, a buttoned-down college lecturer, whose life is turned upside down after learning he has six months to live. To the shock of his wife (Rosemarie DeWitt: La La Land) and school chancellor (Ron Livingston: The Conjuring) and the delight of his students- Richard embarks on a hilarious crusade against authority, with sex, drugs and bad behaviour in this dark comedy.

programme.title: The Adventures of Maid Marian
programme.desc: Everyone knows the stories of Robin Hood and Maid Marian robbing from the rich to give to the poor, daring escapes from the evil Sheriff, sword fights and adventures. They eventually culminate in the arrival of King Richard the Lionheart who grants the outlaw a royal pardon. Most of the stories end here. This is the story of what happens next. A legend returns to save her people again...

programme.title: A Rainy Day in New York
programme.desc: Woody Allen returns to the romantic fields of previous hits Vicky Cristina Barcelona and Midnight in Paris, assembling an all-star cast including Timothée Chalamet, Elle Fanning, Selena Gomez, Jude Law, Diego Luna and Liev Schreiber, for a charming, comedic tale set amidst the dizzying streets of The Big Apple, as romantic weekend plans are soon dashed as quickly as the sunlight turns to showers.

programme.title: Standing Up Falling Down
programme.desc: After four years of chasing his stand-up comedy dream in Los Angeles, 34-year old Scott Rollins has crashed and burned. On a night out, Scott strikes up an unlikely friendship with an eccentric dermatologist, Marty. As their relationship evolves, they realise they need to find the strength to start confronting their long-simmering regrets.

programme.title: Miss Virginia
programme.desc: An inspiring, heart-warming and extremely relevant true story, starring Uzo Aduba (Orange is the New Black), Niles Fitch (This is Us), Matthew Modine (Full Metal Jacket) and Vanessa Williams (Shaft). When Virginia Walden an impoverished single mother is losing her fifteen-year-old son to the rough streets of Washington D.C. she launches a movement to change the system that is responsible.

programme.title: Cold Brook
programme.desc: One fateful evening, after working late hours at the museum, two maintenance workers see a man standing silently near a Civil War exhibit. Despite chasing him away, each night he returns.

programme.title: Dating My Past
programme.desc: A couples therapy expert thinks back on what she's learned from her relationships with three exes: one with whom she can't deny the chemistry, one a sensitive artist, and one that's seemingly too perfect.

programme.title: Last Days In The Desert
programme.desc: In an imagined chapter from his 40 days of fasting in the desert, Jesus tangles with Satan for the souls of a family in crisis.

programme.title: Noah

programme.title: Wedding Season

programme.title: The Last Bridesmaid

programme.title: A Week in Paradise

programme.title: Love Type D
programme.desc: How can someone love you yesterday and not today? Shortly after her boyfriend sends his 12-year-old brother (Wilbur) to break the news that she's dumped, Frankie Browne (27) discovers that she has a loser in love gene. Every man she goes out with will inevitably break up with her.

programme.title: A Rainy Day in New York
programme.desc: Woody Allen's romantic comedy A RAINY DAY IN NEW YORK tells the story of college sweethearts, Gatsby (Timothée Chalamet) and Ashleigh (Elle Fanning), whose plans for a romantic weekend together in New York City are dashed as quickly as the sunlight turns into showers.

programme.title: The Dating List

programme.title: Olympic Dreams
programme.desc: In this heart-warming romantic comedy, an athlete and volunteer form an unexpected bond at the Olympic Games.

programme.title: Return To Me
programme.desc: A man who falls in love with the woman who received his wife's heart must decide which woman it is who holds his heart.

programme.title: Wuthering Heights (1970)
programme.desc: A passionate adaptation of Emily Brontë's superbly strange and hauntingly enduring classic novel, starring Timothy Dalton and Anna Calder-Marshall as the doomed and deathless lovers, Heathcliff and Cathy. Directed by Robert Fuest.

programme.title: Beauty and the Billionaire: Bali
programme.desc: American doctor Ivy Miller lives in Bali, working at a charitable health clinic. When a billionaire benefactor named Dylan Donnelly arrives, Ivy is less than impressed. He is only interested in making himself look better by appearing charitable. Ivy is happy when he goes on his way, but then an accident injures one of Dylan's trusted advisors, Blake. Dylan insists Ivy stay at Dylan's lavish estate in Bali to care for Blake until he's well.

programme.title: Hometown Remedy
programme.desc: A busy surgeon heads back home to celebrate her father becoming mayor. But after a chance encounter with the town's only doctor-and most eligible bachelor-she witnesses true compassion which might be the prescription this doctor needs.

programme.title: Love on Trend
programme.desc: When Allie left her small town to move to San Francisco to pursue her dream of becoming a fashion designer, little did she imagine that the city had big plans for her - and for her heart.

programme.title: Love, Alaska
programme.desc: When two childhood friends are reunited through a generous inheritance that bestows far more on their broken hearts than they bargained for - a second chance at love.

programme.title: Love's Portrait
programme.desc: Lily, a museum curator, discovers a painting that looks just like her and is sent to find where the painting came from and who painted it. She tracks the painting down to the post office it was sent from in Ireland. There she meets William and Saoirse, a brother-sister duo who run the post, and who offer her help and friendship on her quest. But William knows more than he's letting on. Will he reveal what he knows if it risks his growing relationship--and mutual love--with Lily?

programme.title: Fatal Honeymoon
programme.desc: True story: Newlywed dies on honeymoon, husband's guilt investigated.

programme.title: Kidnapping in the Grand Canyon
programme.desc: Best friends' Grand Canyon hike: battling man, nature to escape. Starring Gi.

programme.title: Bridget/Daryl/Ryan B. and John

programme.title: Be Mine
programme.desc: A woman finds romance as she prepares to take over her mother's garden store.

programme.title: Made For You, With Love
programme.desc: A secondhand wedding dress owner helps brides find their dream gowns but fears giving love a second chance.

programme.title: Calling for Love
programme.desc: A podcast host who is cynical about love meets Jake, a charismatic and charming new caller.

programme.title: Maid In Manhattan
programme.desc: A woman (Lopez) takes a job as a chambermaid at a luxury hotel in New York. She meets and falls in love with a debonair heir to an America political dynasty (Fiennes), who mistakes her for a society woman. When her real identity is revealed, the truth sets in about the disparity of their lives.

programme.title: My Best Friend's Wedding (1997)
programme.desc: Two friends (Julia Roberts and Dermot Mulroney) go from an impossible possibility to an unimaginable reality in this romantic comedy.

programme.title: Flow
programme.desc: Sam, 76, a retired poet, is thrown out of his own home by his daughter. His son Bo leaves him at an assisted living facility where old age takes over. Bored out of his mind he approaches another resident Carl and asks him to record a rap song.

programme.title: The Spy Next Door
programme.desc: Former CIA spy takes on his toughest assignment to date: looking after his girlfriend's three kids.

programme.title: Hudson

programme.title: Vampires Suck

Meanwhile, Becca's friends contend with their own romantic issues, all of which collide at the prom.

programme.title: Daniel Boone, Trail Blazer

programme.title: Colt in the Hand of the Devil

programme.title: Ride Out for Revenge
programme.desc: When an Indian chief is murdered in a hateful town, a sympathizing ex marshal tries to stop the Indians from attacking for revenge.

programme.title: To Hell and Back

programme.title: Reverend's Colt

programme.title: It's Not Cricket

programme.title: Man of the Moment

programme.title: Just My Luck

programme.title: Act of Murder
programme.desc: An actor attempts to win back his former mistress by putting stress on her husband.

programme.title: Frightened City
programme.desc: The 'protection racket' is rampant in London.

programme.desc: Germania, ca. 400 AD: an artifact called Gunther's Scepter is sealed in a vault. Kleine Burgh, 2001: Sydney and Nigel are hired to find it using a crystal and a stone tablet.

programme.title: The Executioners Mask

programme.title: The Royal Ring

programme.title: Set in Stone

programme.title: Errol Garner
programme.sub-title: Erroll Garner - Live in Singer Concertzaal, Laren
programme.desc: On June 18, 1962, American pianist and composer Erroll Garner performed at the Singer Concertzaal in Laren. The vibrant and joyous concert was played with drummer Kelly Martin and bassist Eddie Calhoun, each long-standing collaborators from Garner's trio. The Singer Concertzaal in Laren, the Netherlands is a concert hall and museum dedicated to the preservation of the art collection of American William Henry Singer. It features a variety of artists, both visual and aural.

programme.title: Christian McBride
programme.desc: On July 20, 2018, double bassist Christian McBride presented his band ‘New Jawn' at the Malta Jazz Festival. A five-time Grammy winner, McBride is one of the most requested, most recorded, and most respected figures in the music world today. Hailing from Philadelphia, this music luminary combines jazz, R&B, pop/rock, hip hop/neo-soul, and classical. Gracing the Malta Jazz stage with him are Nasheet Waits (drums), Marcus Strickland (tenor sax), and Josh Evans (trumpet).

programme.title: Antibalas, Bettye LaVette, José James & Alice Russell
programme.desc: To close its 2019 edition, Jazz à la Villette pays tribute to the queen of soul Aretha Franklin, who died in the summer of 2018. The musical direction of the evening has been entrusted to Antibalas, an Afrobeat group from Brooklyn attached to the Daptones label, accompanied for the occasion by several guest singers: Bettye LaVette, José James, Alice Russell, Nona Hendryx & Zara McFarlane.

programme.title: Cannonball Adderley
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Gary Burton & Makoto Ozone
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic. In 1995, vibraphonist Gary Burton and pianist Makoto Ozone, both great jazz players noted for their virtuoso technique and innovative style, came together to give a concert of improvised music. They delighted the audience with their fluid, poetic artistry, which was expressed in a performance of the highest order.

programme.title: Wes Montgomery
programme.desc: This selection of unforgettable performances by some of the most iconic and influential jazz guitarists in history showcases these legends' unique essence. Revel in Wes Montgomery's virtuosity as he performs the captivating “Nica's Dream” in Holland in 1965, and delight in the expressive beauty of his rendition of “Here's That Rainy Day”, recorded in London in that same year. Experience the timeless appeal of Joe Pass's “You Stepped Out of a Dream” and “You Turned The Tables on Me”, recorded live in Hanover in 1975. The interplay between Jim Hall and Atilla Zoller borders on the impossible as they perform “Extensions” in Hanover in 1973. Enjoy Jim Hall's lyrical solo performance of “I'm Getting Sentimental Over You” from 1964. Witness Sonny Sharrock's avant-garde fusion of jazz and rock in an exhilarating performance of “Peanut", recorded live in France in 1970. Sharrock is joined by flutist Herbie Mann in a soulful performance of “Memphis Underground” from 1969. Immerse yourself in the magic of jazz guitar!

programme.title: Dionne Warwick
programme.sub-title: Dionne Warwick live at the 27 Club
programme.desc: Dionne Warwick's vocal artistry ranges from voluminous deep register to soft, fragile high notes. She masters the entire range with almost unnerving ease. But more than her strong, warm voice, Dionne's magic is in the silky elegance and the secure delivery with which she tells a story. That's how her, along with composer Burt Bacharach and lyricist Hal David become pioneers of the brand of pop music called “Middle of the Road”, meaning pop that is grippingly simple, but never trite. Sixty of her hits made it into the American charts and sold over 100 million albums worldwide. This amazing 1964 recording from the 27 Club in Knokke, Belgium showcases the 23-year-old star vocalist at the start of her career.

programme.title: Spyro Gyra
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival's staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1982, the American jazz fusion band Spyro Gyra took the stage at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague. Having struck gold with their album "Morning Dance" just a few years prior, they played a slick set with exuberant energy.

programme.title: Franz Welser-Möst, Cleveland Orchestra & Víkingur Ólafsson
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst conducts the Cleveland Orchestra in a program recorded at Severance Music Center in Cleveland in March 2023. On the program are Louise Farrenc's Symphony No. 3, Ravel's Piano Concerto in G (featuring Vïkingur Ólafsson as soloist) and Mussorgsky's Pictures at an Exhibition (orchestration by Ravel).

programme.title: Soloists of the Lucerne Festival Orchestra
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Philippe Jordan & Orchestre de l'Opéra national de Paris
programme.sub-title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 6 in F major, Op. 68
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l'Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven's symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven's Symphony No. 6 in F major, Op. 68, also known as the Pastoral Symphony. Beethoven wrote the work upon completion of his Symphony No. 5. Both symphonies premiered at the same legendary, all-Beethoven concert on December 22, 1808. Symphony No. 6 consists of five movements, of which the last three are played without a break. Each movement carries a title that suggests a scene from life in the countryside. The joyful atmosphere of the first three movements is interrupted by the violent fourth movement ‘Thunder, Storm', as expressed by the piccolos, brass, and timpani. As the storm recedes at the end of the movement, the tranquility returns in the final movement. This performance was recorded at Opéra Bastille in Paris, France, in 2015.

programme.title: Carlos Miguel Prieto, Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería, Ruxandra Donose & Ramón Vargas
programme.sub-title: Mahler – The Song of the Earth
programme.desc: Mahler: Das Lied von der Erde, performed live by Carlos Miguel Prieto conducting the Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería, with mezzo-soprano Ruxandra Donose and tenor Ramón Vargas, presents Mahler's song-symphony — one of the composer's most profound masterpieces.

programme.title: Mariss Jansons, Berliner Philharmoniker & Hilary Hahn
programme.desc: The Berliner Philharmoniker is one of the world's finest orchestras, its fame stretching all the way to Japan. Unsurprisingly, this 2000 concert, recorded at Tokyo's magnificent Suntory Hall, was a resounding success. programme.desc: Ally ha estado cuidando a Sunshine, un perro militar retirado, mientras se recupera de una ruptura. Pero las chispas vuelven a volar cuando el militar, Jake Terry, regresa para reclamar el perro.

programme.title: Sazonado con amor

programme.title: Tsotsi
programme.desc: En uno de los barrios más miserables de Johannesburgo (Sudáfrica), Tsotsi, un chaval de 19 años, ha borrado todos sus recuerdos, incluyendo su nombre real. Tsotsi significa "matón" o "gangster" en el argot callejero del gueto. Huérfano desde muy pequeño y obligado a salir adelante por sus propios medios, Tsotsi ha llevado una vida de privaciones extremas, tanto físicas como psíquicas. Tiene escasa conciencia de los sentimientos de los demás y se ha endurecido borrando cualquier sentido de la compasión. Gobernado por el impulso y el instinto, le mueve el miedo que inspira a otros. Sin nombre, sin pasado, sin ningún plan para el futuro, en un presente lleno de rabia, Tsotsi lidera su propio grupo de marginados sociales...

programme.title: Primavera tardía
programme.desc: Noriko tiene 27 años y vive con su padre viudo. Todos intentan convencerla de que se case, pero ella quiere quedarse en casa cuidando de su padre.

programme.title: La lectora
programme.desc: Constance es una chica a la que le gusta leer. La lectura es para ella fantasía, sueño, imagen de un mundo irrealizable pero bello. Leyendo la novela «La lectora» se identifica con María, su protagonista. Una y otra, en la realidad y en la ficción, irán descubriendo los sabores de la vida. Cada palabra es un goce, un paso profundo en el conocimiento, en los placeres de la libertad y la belleza. Provocación, encanto, placer, deseo, perversidad e inocencia... mucho más que simple erotismo.

programme.title: Herida
programme.desc: Stephen Fleming es un médico londinense y diputado conservador. Está casado con Ingrid, rica heredera, con quien tiene dos hijos: la adolescente Ally y Martyn, prometedor periodista. En una fiesta, Stephen conoce a la novia de su hijo, Anna y surge entre ellos una pasión irrefrenable. Anna ya ha conocido la tragedia tras tener una relación similar, e intenta poner fin a la intensidad animal que les une. Sin embargo, hay algunas historias que conducen a la fatalidad sin remedio.

programme.title: Diarios de Motocicleta
programme.desc: En 1952, dos jóvenes argentinos, Ernesto Guevara y Alberto Granado, emprenden un viaje por carretera para descubrir la verdadera América Latina. Los dos amigos dejan Buenos Aires en una desvencijada motocicleta Norton de 500cc del año 1939, llevados por un romántico espíritu aventurero. Sus experiencias harán despertar en ellos a los hombres en que se convertirán en el futuro y que definirán sus vidas.

programme.title: Prisioneros del sol
programme.desc: Una expedición multinacional descubre una ciudad perdida bajo una pirámide en la que tendrán que detener a los dioses del antiguo Egipto que han despertado para iniciar el apocalipsis.

programme.title: El dulce porvenir
programme.desc: Un autobús escolar se despeña montaña abajo y se hunde en un lago helado. En el accidente mueren todos los niños del pueblo. El abogado Mitchell Stevens se entrevista con los padres y les propone llevar el caso a los tribunales.

programme.title: El balneario de Battle Creek
programme.desc: El excéntrico doctor John Harvey Kellog es un defensor acérrimo de la vida natural y también regenta un lujoso balneario en Battle Creek, donde reúne a numerosos personajes de clase alta para poner en práctica sus peculiares normas dieteticas.

programme.title: 1492: La conquista del paraíso
programme.desc: Retrata la vida del atrevido explorador Cristóbal Colón. Un difícil y sorprendente viaje hasta una tierra desconocida por el mundo, América el efecto sobre las tribus indígenas y la vuelta del héroe a España hasta su muerte.

programme.title: Matar por popularidad
programme.desc: Una cuenta revela escándalos de un instituto y dos amigas buscan desenmascarar al responsable.

programme.title: Traición conyugal

programme.title: El final del asesino de libros

programme.title: Doble venganza
programme.desc: Tras la muerte de su padre y de su madre en un accidente, Gina culpa al capataz de su desgracia.

programme.title: Matar por popularidad
programme.desc: Una cuenta revela escándalos de un instituto y dos amigas buscan desenmascarar al responsable.

programme.title: La sombra del pasado
programme.desc: Kurt es un joven estudiante de arte en la Alemania del Este, enamorado de su compañera de clase, Ellie. El padre de ella, no aprueba la relación de su hija y está decidido a destruirla. Ninguno de ellos sabe es que sus vidas están conectadas por un terrible crimen cometido hace décadas.

programme.title: La casa de la esperanza
programme.desc: Una historia conmovedora basada en el hecho real más curioso de la II GM. El director del zoo de Varsovia y su esposa (Jessica Chastain), ayudaron a salvar a cientos de personas (y también a muchos animales del Zoo) de los nazis tras la invasión de Polonia por las tropas alemanas en 1939.

programme.title: Azul y no tan rosa
programme.desc: Diego es un joven fotógrafo exitoso que vive en el glamoroso mundo de la moda, la superficialidad y el exceso. Un brutal ataque homófobo trastoca su vida cuando su pareja queda en coma. Justo en ese terrible momento, Diego, inesperadamente, debe cuidar de su hijo Armando...

programme.title: Libertad
programme.desc: Basada en una historia real. Dos hombres separados por 100 años están unidos en su búsqueda hacia la libertad. En 1856, un esclavo, Samuel Woodward y su familia, escapan de la plantación Monroe cerca de Virginia.

programme.title: El hombre más buscado
programme.desc: Sobria película de espías a la vieja escuela llena de tensión y suspense. Un joven ruso sin papeles consigue llegar a la ciudad de Hamburgo. Lleva encima una sorprendente cantidad de dinero. Annabel, una abogada defensora de derechos civiles, intenta que no lo deporten.

programme.title: Si no despierto
programme.desc: Fantasía juvenil seria y sincera sobre el destino, que tiene suficiente dimensión trágica para atraer a los jóvenes y a los amantes del entretenimiento con mensaje positivo. Una chica tiene la oportunidad de revivir 7 veces su último día de vida para desvelar el misterio que rodea su muerte.

programme.title: Falling
programme.desc: John vive con su novio Eric y la hija adoptiva de ambos en el sur de California. Su padre Willis un granjero tradicional y conservador de 80 años, decide viajar a Los Ángeles y quedarse en casa de John mientras busca el lugar idóneo para jubilarse.

programme.title: La Marca Del Lobo
programme.desc: Una muchacha presenció el asesinato de su familia. La joven sobrevivió adentrándose en el bosque.

programme.title: Love's Kitchen
programme.desc: Bob, un exitoso chef, rehace su vida en un restaurante rural. Allí volverá a creer en el amor.

programme.title: El Chico De La Burbuja De Plástico
programme.desc: Un niño que nace con una deficiencia en su sistema inmunológico

programme.title: New York, I Love You

programme.title: Encontrando el Fin del Mundo
programme.desc: Tras la muerte de su esposa y su hijo menor, Jorge, un músico desempleado, queda a cargo de su hijo mayor.

Allí tratará de descifrar que es lo que más desea, si seguir jugando al fútbol y continuar con su antiguo amor o darle un cambio de rumbo a su vida.

programme.title: El Skylab
programme.desc: Julio de 1979. Albertine, de diez años, y sus familiares se reúnen en una casa de Bretaña para celebrar el cumpleaños de la abu…

programme.title: Guerra de misses

Otro año más los vecinos de Charmoussey, un pueblecito del fondo del valle hundido por la recesión, se conjuran para arrebatarle al fin la victoria a la localidad rival. Vale cualquier medio: espionaje, delación, corrupción... La guerra de misses no ha hecho más que empezar.

programme.title: La mirada del amor
programme.desc: Cinco años después de perder el amor de su vida, Nikki se enamora de nuevo a primera vista. Tom es el hombre de sus sueños un atractivo profesor de arte con un gran corazón, sonrisa amable y mucha vitalidad. Su parecido físico con Garrett, su difunto marido, es asombroso. Seducida por la oportunidad de volver a vivir su primer amor verdadero, Nikki se sumerge en un mundo de fantasía con Tom como Garrett, sabiendo que tarde o temprano deberá revelar la verdad.

programme.title: La cosecha
programme.desc: Charlie Pope, un guionista de cine en plena depresión, es acuciado por un productor para que finalice el guion en el que está trabajando. Cuando lo envían a un viaje de investigación a un colorido centro turístico en México, una serie de eventos extraños transportan a Charlie a un mundo de pesadilla, seducción e intriga.

programme.title: Especiales
programme.desc: La historia de Bruno y Malik, dos amigos que durante veinte años han vivido en un mundo diferente: el de los niños y adolescentes autistas. A cargo de dos organizaciones sin ánimo de lucro, forman a jóvenes para que sean cuidadores de casos extremos. De esta forma crean una asociación excepcional, fuera de los entornos tradicionales, para unas personas extraordinarias.

programme.title: Buffaloed
programme.desc: Joven entra en el mundo de la cobranza de deudas.

programme.title: Rivales

programme.title: Ya te extraño
programme.desc: Amistad femenina enfrenta cáncer y embarazo.

programme.title: Las Fantasías
programme.desc: Seis parejas explosivas dispuestas a dar rienda suelta a sus fantasías más íntimas. Desde los juegos de rol a la abstinencia, pasando por el exhibicionismo. Una comedia con un reparto de primer nivel que examina nuestra libertad de amar como pocas veces se ha visto en el cine.

programme.title: Un hombre llamado Ove
programme.desc: Ove no es el típico vecino con el que apetece cruzarte en el barrio. Es un cascarrabias, un pesado que insiste hasta la exageración en mantener el orden y la disciplina, un casi sesentón solitario y resentido a quien el destino ha arrebatado demasiadas cosas.

programme.title: Pequeño Manhattan
programme.desc: Little Manhattan es una agradable comedia perfecta tanto para niños como para adultos. En una ciudad conocida por su agitación, dos jóvenes amigos se embarcan en la mayor aventura de su vida.

programme.title: Lilo, mi amigo el cocodrilo
programme.desc: Cuando la familia Primm se muda a la ciudad de Nueva York, su joven hijo Josh lucha por adaptarse a su nueva escuela y a sus nuevos amigos. Todo cambia cuando descubre a Lyle -un cocodrilo cantante al que le encantan los baños, el caviar y la buena música- viviendo en el ático de su nueva casa. Los dos se hacen amigos rápidamente, pero cuando la existencia de Lyle se ve amenazada por el malvado vecino Sr. Cascarrabias, los Primm deben unirse con el carismático dueño de Lyle, Héctor P. Valenti, para demostrar al mundo que la familia puede venir de los lugares más inesperados y que no hay nada malo en un gran cocodrilo cantante con una personalidad aún mayor.

programme.title: Una Madre Imperfecta
programme.desc: La cinta nos cuenta la historia de Marnie (Susan Sarandon), una viuda no acostumbrada a su nueva situación emocional que decide recoger sus cosas y trasladarse a Hollywood con el objetivo de estar más cerca de su hija. No obstante, y sin quererlo, comienza a interferir en la vida de ésta, Lori (Rose Byrne). Es entonces cuando se ve obligada a empezar de nuevo desde el principio en un lugar desconocido encontrando por el camino nuevos amigos, nuevas experiencias y nuevas personas que la necesitan.

programme.title: Ese Poli Es Un Panoli
programme.desc: Las cosas no salen como se planearon cuando un detective implacable planea una vigilancia en la casa de los Robbersons, junto a la cual está la de un matón de la mafia.

programme.title: Dick y Jane Ladrones de Risa
programme.desc: Nada más ascender, el ambicioso Dick se ve obligado a comparecer ante las cámaras de televisión para explicar por qué el presidente de su empresa Globodyne se ha desecho repentinamente de sus acciones. Dick se ve envuelto en una especie de escándalo corporativo: en un instante pierde todo lo que pensaba que tenía.

programme.title: La calle de los conflictos
programme.desc: En Abilene, Kansas, tras la Guerra Civil, una frágil tregua divide la ciudad entre colonos y ganaderos. Cuando nuevos colonos se establecen en el lado equivocado, el equilibrio se rompe y estalla un conflicto abierto por la tierra, enfrentando a quienes buscan propiedad y cultivo contra quienes defienden el libre pastoreo.

programme.title: Duelo al sol
programme.desc: Tras la ejecución de su padre, Pearl se muda con parientes en Texas, donde su belleza desata tensiones. Mientras el senador McCanles la desprecia, su hijo rebelde Lewt se obsesiona con ella, y el noble Jesse intenta protegerla. Los deseos, celos y secretos familiares pronto conducen al desastre.

programme.title: El cazador de forajidos
programme.desc: Una banda que trabaja para La Sombra está aterrorizando al pueblo. John Travers decide asumir el trabajo de sheriff y hacer algo al respecto.

programme.title: ...Y le llamaban El Halcón
programme.desc: Gianni Garko regresa como el Espíritu Santo, un pistolero sobrenatural vestido de blanco y con una paloma al hombro.

programme.title: En el viejo Oklahoma
programme.desc: En 1906, en las tierras indias de Oklahoma, un vaquero lucha por los derechos de arrendamiento de petróleo contra un codicioso petrolero mientras una bonita maestra de escuela roba el corazón de ambos.

programme.title: La trampa del diablo
programme.desc: En 7 minutos la vida de Thomas Conrad en Nogales, Arizona, cambiará para siempre cuando se vea atrapado en un juego macabro entre los cárteles mexicanos de las drogas y sus mulas.

programme.title: Te pido un taxi
programme.desc: Rodrigo está seguro de poder conquistarlas a todas, y nunca se queda con ninguna, porque para él, el amor no existe. En éste, su juego, se encontrará con Sol, quién romperá toda regla que él se ha impuesto.

programme.title: Una noche sin luna
programme.desc: Durante la noche de fin de año, tres personajes solitarios llegan a un pequeño pueblo perdido en el campo uruguayo donde tendrán una oportunidad para cambiar su destino.

programme.title: Fuera del menú
programme.desc: Un soltero de tercera generación de la gran cadena Tortilla Hut tiene que encontrar un nuevo plato para la cadena. Conoce a una guapa y magnífica chef en un restaurante de un pueblo de Nuevo México.

programme.title: La casa del río
programme.desc: Una enfermera de un pequeño pueblo lidera a sus vecinos de clase obrera en su lucha por salvar sus hogares frente a los intereses políticos y corporativos que quieren dar la tierra a la Pfizer Corporation.

programme.title: Primavera en Normandía
programme.desc: Martin es un ex parisino que ha regresado a su pueblo natal en Normandía para hacerse cargo de la panadería de su padre. De su juventud le queda una gran imaginación y su pasión por la literatura, con un profundo aprecio por Gustave Flaubert. La emoción le invade cuando un matrimonio inglés se instala en la casa vecina, no sólo porque sus nombres son Gemma y Charles Bovery, sino porque sus comportamientos parecen replicar los de los personajes de la obra Madame Bovary, que incluye una serie de relaciones románticas y sexuales que se encaminan hacia un final incierto. Pero la hermosa Gemma no ha leído la novela clásica, y tiene la intención de vivir su propia vida, en especial cuando su antiguo novio, Patrick, aparezca de nuevo en su vida.

programme.title: The winter lake
programme.desc: Después de hacer un descubrimiento sombrío en un lago estacional, un adolescente retraído descubre la verdad sobre sus vecinos, un padre y una hija que albergan secretos siniestros.

programme.title: Jake
programme.desc: Una pareja casada, Alex y Greg, tiene que afrontar un conflicto cuando descubre que su hijo prefiere a la Cenicienta en lugar de los G.I. Joe.

programme.title: Anita no pierde el tren
programme.desc: Anita ve como derriban el cine en el que trabaja como taquillera. A partir de ese día su vida cambia.

programme.title: En temporada baja
programme.desc: Sigue la supuesta camaradería formada por Alberto, "el crack", quien fue un exitoso representante de futbolistas que ahora vive en un camping a las afueras de Valencia, y Charly, un policía divorciado que duerme en el trabajo.

programme.title: Amalia en el otoño
programme.desc: Isabel está preocupada por su madre Amalia, en una residencia.. Poco después, la COVID-19 aparece en la vida de todos.

programme.title: El pomo azul
programme.desc: Soledad, que forma una pareja aparentemente consolidada con Juan, busca el piso más apropiado para su futuro en común.

programme.title: Cuadecuc Vampir
programme.desc: An analysis of the construction mechanism for the magic in dominant narrative cinema though the filming of Nachts, wenn Dracula erwacht (1970), a commercial film by Jesus Franco.

programme.title: Raw Meat
programme.desc: When a government official disappears in the London tunnels, after several reports of missing people in the same location, Scotland Yard start to take the matter seriously,

programme.title: Inhumano
programme.desc: Mickey está a punto de obtener su gran oportunidad como cineasta aficionado, de un asesino en serie que lo convierte a él y a su cámara en "el testigo perfecto".

programme.title: Point Defiance
programme.desc: A bachelor's beautiful, isolated home becomes a hostile prison when his troubled brother returns from military duty in Afghanistan, forcing them to unearth their violent past before another dark secret is buried.

programme.title: Gun shy
programme.desc: La historia sigue a Turk Henry (Antonio Banderas), una superestrella del rock con discos de platino, casado con una supermodelo (Olga Kurylenko) y más rico de lo que jamás soñó. Durante unas vacaciones, su esposa es misteriosamente secuestrada por un grupo de piratas renegados sin barco. Con poca ayuda de las autoridades locales, Turk se ve obligado a embarcarse en una misión para rescatarla. Con habilidades más aptas para tocar el bajo, ligar y salir de fiesta, tendrá que enfrentarse a peligrosas selvas y a despiadados bandidos en esta divertida y trepidante aventura llena de acción.

programme.title: Vacaciones en el Infierno
programme.desc: Detenido y encarcelado en una prisión mexicana por tráfico de drogas, un hombre aprende a sobrevivir en este entorno hostil con la ayuda de un niño de 9 años.

programme.title: Cut off (esp)
programme.desc: El policía forense Paul Herzfeld encuentra dentro de la cabeza de un cuerpo mutilado una cápsula que contiene un número de teléfono y el nombre de su hija.

programme.title: Avalanche Sharks
programme.desc: Después de una terrible avalancha, el personal de Twin Pines Resort Sky comienza a recibir informes sobre personas que han desaparecido y criaturas que se mueven bajo la nieve.

programme.title: Espacio/Tiempo
programme.desc: En un futuro al borde del colapso, unos científicos desarrollan una turbina para realizar viajes interestelares que podría salvar a la humanidad. Cuando les cortan la financiación por un fatal accidente, deciden recurrir a actividades delictivas para reconstruir su máquina.

programme.title: Valentine, venganza oscura
programme.desc: La tranquila ciudad de Batavia ya no es lo que era. La violencia, los robos y la gran tasa de criminalidad hacen de sus calles un lugar inhabitable. En medio de ese caos vive Srimaya, una joven aspirante a actriz que, acabará convirtiéndose en una superheroína para acabar con el crimen de la ciudad.

programme.title: Tracers
programme.desc: Un mensajero de Nueva York (Taylor Lautner) se ve envuelto en una trama criminal. 'Tracers' está ambientada en el espectacular mundo del parkour, una técnica de desplazamiento en la que hay que superar todos los obstáculos usando las habilidades del cuerpo humano: saltando vallas, muros, etc.

programme.title: Juntos para vencer
programme.desc: Un adolescente acosado que sueña con ser el compañero de Chuck Norris se entrena en artes marciales para hacer realidad sus sueños.

programme.title: Hombres Muertos
programme.desc: En el Oeste, dos hermanos buscan vengar a su padre, proteger a los apaches y recuperar sus tierras.

programme.title: El ataque del tiburón de seis cabezas
programme.desc: Una escapada romántica en una isla remota se vuelve una pesadilla cuando un tiburón de seis cabezas ataca.

programme.title: Mega Python vs. Gatoroid
programme.desc: Una especie de pitón gigante invade los Everglades.

programme.title: En nombre del rey
programme.desc: Un hombre llamado Farmer se propone rescatar a su esposa secuestrada y vengar la muerte de su hijo.

programme.title: En Primera Línea
programme.desc: En 1968, un equipo en Vietnam enfrenta tensiones raciales, crisis morales y el peso de la guerra.

programme.title: The Adventures Of Tintin
programme.desc: Un joven reportero llamado Tintín y su perro, un terrier llamado Milú, viajan por todo el mundo viviendo numerosas aventuras.

programme.title: The Dark Tower (2017)
programme.desc: Un mundo moribundo. Un paisaje del viejo oeste, donde el tiempo no corre de forma normal, donde ciudades y regiones enteras desaparecieron sin dejar rastro.
